learning_objective: 🎯 Master reading, writing, and estimating huge numbers like crores and billions to understand real-world data like country populations and distances in space!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In India, we organize large numbers using Lakhs and Crores. We place the first comma after the hundreds place (three digits from the right), and then a comma after every two digits!
Around the world, people group numbers by Millions and Billions. In this system, commas are placed after every three digits from the right, making it super easy to read global data.
Did you know that 10 Lakhs is exactly the same as 1 Million? And 1 Crore is equal to 10 Million! Understanding both helps us read international news and science facts.

Sometimes we do not need an exact count, like the number of stars in a galaxy. Estimation is mathematical guessing by rounding off numbers to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand to make calculations faster.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Digroz Learning Space Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Search for the exact distance from the Earth to the Sun in kilometers. Write this massive number down in both the Indian and International systems, then share your estimated round-off in your study notes!

quick_recap: ⭐ Commas are our best friends for reading large numbers quickly without getting confused.
⭐ The Indian system uses 3-2-2 grouping, while the International system uses 3-3-3 grouping.
⭐ Estimation helps us make quick, smart approximations in daily life!
